title: How to Trade with Skrell
author: Fizzek Drainmouth, Honest
pages: Hello reader. You are buying from skrell. Good choice. Here are the rules so nobody gets stabbed, which is bad for business. Rule one: we can tell when you are lying, because we are better at it.
Rule two: always haggle. If you pay the first price we think you are sad or rich. If sad, we give you soup. If rich, we tell our cousins. Our cousins are not as nice as me.
Rule three: shiny things are worth more than heavy things. Copper is pretty. Gold is very pretty. Iron is fine, we suppose. Do not bring us lead. We know what lead is.
Rule four: we trade at night. Sun-people will not, which is silly, because night is when the good stuff turns up. Do not ask where it came from. It came from the Gutter. Everything does.
Rule five: favours are money. If a skrell says you owe one, you do. Pay before Moot-day. If you do not, nothing bad will happen. Probably. Rule six: watch your purse. Sorry. Here it is.
